observations: body L1-L4: the heads are in small capitals, each over a brace that spans its column. From Schram's day numbers on p. 212 the intervals are 93d 12h 21m,5, 186d 14h 6m,3 and 178d 15h 42m,8 for 882 (printed 42, 5) and 93d 12h 15m,8 and 186d 14h 8m,2 for 883 (printed 8, 0; the hours and minutes of p. 212 give 8m,1). The d after 93 in the column of 883 is printed without its bowl, like an l.
body L6-L7, L9, L14, L20, L26-L27: the dashes of «146–148», «85–86», «al–ḥarakah», «al–Battānī», «188–190» and «Sūrya–siddhānta» are long dashes (4.3 to 5.4 pt).
body L8: in the head the dash after «b)» measures 10.0 pt and is transcribed as a dash.

body L22-L25: the greatest equation of the centre is 1° 55′ 18″,8 for the eccentricity 0,016 771 063 and 1° 58′ 8″,6 for 0,017 182 700; the 1° 58′ 2″,85 printed for 880 is about 6″ smaller than the eccentricity printed with it requires.
notes_left L5, L7-L8: the dashes of «al-Battānī», «al-Bīrūnī», «al-ḥāṣṣah» and «al-khāṣṣah» measure 3.1 to 4.2 pt and are transcribed as hyphens.
